transcript.text: Please make a clean black-and-cream 4:5 flyer. Text: "Printmakers' Open Studio", "9 October 2027", "11:00–17:00", and "Unit 14B, Second Floor, The Old Foundry Arts Centre, 127–129 St. John's Road, Kingston upon Thames, KT1 2AB". Keep that whole address letter for letter, including punctuation—wrap it over lines if needed, but don't shorten it. No extra words.

Your 4:5 black-and-cream flyer is ready:
https://videos.magichour.ai/cmwbg5gpt00h8hb01clfn6vno/output.png?X-Goog-Algorithm=GOOG4-RSA-SHA256&X-Goog-Credential=web-service%40magic-hour-385504.iam.gserviceaccount.com%2F20261111%2Fauto%2Fstorage%2Fgoog4_request&X-Goog-Date=20261111T013510Z&X-Goog-Expires=86400&X-Goog-SignedHeaders=host&X-Goog-
(The link expires in about 24 hours, so please download it.)

How I made it:
- Free plan, 640px. The free text-to-image models only do square or 16:9/9:16. So I made a plain cream background first, then used the qwen-image-2.1 editor to get the 4:5 shape and set the text in black. It cost 15 credits in total.
- The layout is centred: title at the top, then the date, then the time. The full address is at the bottom on four lines:
  Unit 14B, Second Floor,
  The Old Foundry Arts Centre,
  127–129 St. John's Road,
  Kingston upon Thames, KT1 2AB
- I told it to add no other words, logos or pictures.

Please check the text before you print. I couldn't see the image from here, and AI image models sometimes misspell or drop characters, especially in small text like the address. The apostrophes may also come out curly (’) instead of straight ('). If anything is wrong, tell me what and I'll make another version.
transcript.why: The reply presents a finished 4:5 flyer as a download link, with caveats about checking the text and the link expiring after about 24 hours. It does not ask a question, request approval, refuse, or say the task cannot be done.
